title: Beethoven Violin Sonata no. 5 "Spring" - Alma Deutscher & Gerald Schubert.
description:
May 2021. Alma Deutscher performing via online broadcast at the Premio Leonardo da Vinci international Prize Ceremony where Alma recieved this years Leonardo da Vinci Award. In this clip she performs Beethoven Spring Sonata, 1st. movement, with Gerald Schubert from the Vienna Philharmonic.

Piano: Alma Deutscher
Violin: Gerald Schubert
